# pickup

> pickup is a command-line tool that watches GitHub PR review comments for `@pickup` mentions and replies with an explanation or a generated fix.

Important notes:

- Development of this repository requires [Nub](https://nubjs.com); end users will be able to install the published package with npm once it ships.
- The CLI entry point is `pickup watch <pr-url-or-shorthand>`, with `--interval`, `--fix`, `--model`, `--provider`, `--prompt`, `--dry-run`, `--json`, and `--user` flags.
- It shells out to `gh`, `git`, and a `claude`-shaped provider CLI; Node.js 24+ is required.
